Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The default implementation of java.lang.Thread's run method only performs a task passed as a Runnable. If no Runnable has been provided at construction time, then the thread will not perform any action. Therefore, this code does not provide a specific 'run' behavior and is not compliant.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testBugTriggered triggers the bug by starting the MyThread instance without providing a specific run behavior. This causes the thread to not perform any action, and the assertion in the test case fails.
